meta.source: Pinneds design system v1 (Oct 29 2026). Edit this file, then run npm run tokens.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Board ground — the page behind stickers and prints. Never put long text straight on a photo; text sits here or on surface-raised.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Everything you read or press: sheets, the dock, prints' borders, inputs, tags, chips.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells and placeholders: image slots before they load, empty tray slots, neutral tags.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunk. Also the picked-sticker ring.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (owner names, counts, help lines) on surface and surface-raised. 4.5:1 in every skin.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and quiet card edges. Decorative only — never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of controls: inputs, secondary buttons, chips, empty tray slots. 3:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The skin's 'pin head' colour: fill of the one primary button per view, pushpins, active marks. Never body text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent used as text or icon on surface or surface-raised (links, 'Remix of…').

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: Dot-sticker fill: picked-number badges, 'Suggested' tags, highlights. Always paired with a number, word or ring — never colour alone.

tokens.name: on-mark
tokens.usage: Text on a mark fill.

tokens.name: keyline
tokens.usage: The die-cut border around every cut-out sticker.

tokens.name: shade
tokens.usage: Shadow colour under stickers (CSS drop-shadow follows the cut-out's shape). Hard and solid in Zine.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind open sheets.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in every skin.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and error lines (text or icon) on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: person-1
tokens.usage: Person colour 1 of 6 — avatar discs and owner dots, picked by a stable hash of the person's id. Always shown with the person's name.

tokens.name: person-2
tokens.usage: Person colour 2 of 6 — avatar discs and owner dots, picked by a stable hash of the person's id. Always shown with the person's name.

tokens.name: person-3
tokens.usage: Person colour 3 of 6 — avatar discs and owner dots, picked by a stable hash of the person's id. Always shown with the person's name.

tokens.name: person-4
tokens.usage: Person colour 4 of 6 — avatar discs and owner dots, picked by a stable hash of the person's id. Always shown with the person's name.

tokens.name: person-5
tokens.usage: Person colour 5 of 6 — avatar discs and owner dots, picked by a stable hash of the person's id. Always shown with the person's name.

tokens.name: person-6
tokens.usage: Person colour 6 of 6 — avatar discs and owner dots, picked by a stable hash of the person's id. Always shown with the person's name.

tokens.name: on-person
tokens.usage: Initials on a person-n disc.

tokens.name: foil-a
tokens.usage: Foil sheen, pink stop. Board Plus foil stickers only; an effect laid over a cut-out, never text or fills. Same in every skin.

tokens.name: foil-b
tokens.usage: Foil sheen, cyan stop. Board Plus foil stickers only; an effect laid over a cut-out, never text or fills. Same in every skin.

tokens.name: foil-c
tokens.usage: Foil sheen, yellow stop. Board Plus foil stickers only; an effect laid over a cut-out, never text or fills. Same in every skin.

shadow.note: Box shadows for prints, the dock and sheets. Stickers use CSS drop-shadow with the shade colour instead, so the shadow follows the cut-out.

tokens.name: shadow-print
tokens.usage: Under scene prints. A print should feel like paper lying on the board.

tokens.name: shadow-dock
tokens.usage: The floating dock at the bottom of the board.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets (Add photo, Make a scene, skin picker).

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: Buttons' resting shadow. Only Cork (a pressed card edge) and Zine (hard offset) use one.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Landing page only, one per screen.

styles.name: board-title
styles.usage: The board's name, top of the board. Always in the skin's display face (--skin-display).

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section heads on the board and sheet titles.

styles.name: title-cork
styles.usage: Cork's board title: Fraunces, soft and homey.

styles.name: title-fridge
styles.usage: Fridge's board title: Fredoka, round like letter magnets.

styles.name: title-zine
styles.usage: Zine's board title: Anton, set in capitals.

styles.name: title-darkroom
styles.usage: Darkroom's board title: Instrument Serif italic.

styles.name: title-postcard
styles.usage: Postcard's board title: Young Serif, like a travel stamp.

styles.name: title-marigold
styles.usage: Marigold's board title: Abril Fatface, a fiesta-poster serif (seasonal Plus skin).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Add a photo and we'll cut out the things in it.
styles.usage: Default reading text. Never smaller than 16px for sentences.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Scene ideas (prompts) under a print; emphasis in a sentence.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Thing names under stickers, chip text, field labels.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button and dock labels. Verb first, sentence case.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Owner names under a thing, small help lines. ink-muted.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Uppercase tags: Made from, Collage, Remix, Suggested.

styles.name: count
styles.usage: Numbers in dot stickers (picked order) and tray counts.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips and tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in the dock; tag padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a sticker and its name; list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between board sections; sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap above a section head.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top of the board under the header.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Landing page rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags and Zine buttons.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Cork and Postcard buttons; image corners inside a print.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, hints, chips' thumbnails, sheets' inner cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheet top corners; the dock.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill buttons, chips, avatars, dot stickers.

size.note: Fixed sizes for targets, avatars, keylines and the sticker grid.

tokens.name: tap
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything tappable.

tokens.name: tap-main
tokens.usage: The primary action in the dock and sheets.

tokens.name: avatar
tokens.usage: Avatar disc in stacks and credit lines.

tokens.name: avatar-sm
tokens.usage: Small avatar disc on the board meta line, before the counts.

tokens.name: avatar-lg
tokens.usage: Avatar on the join card / profile.

tokens.name: keyline-2
tokens.usage: Thin die-cut keyline (Darkroom).

tokens.name: keyline-3
tokens.usage: Standard die-cut keyline (Paper, Cork, Postcard).

tokens.name: keyline-4
tokens.usage: Chunky die-cut keyline (Fridge).

tokens.name: sticker
tokens.usage: A sticker's box on the board grid at 390px wide (3 across).

tokens.name: print-frame-max
tokens.usage: Tallest a scene picture gets in the board strip: a tall print narrows so it and its caption fit a 390x844 screen above the dock.

tilt.note: How far stickers rotate. Each sticker gets a stable factor between -1 and 1 from its id; the skin picks the maximum.

tokens.name: tilt-0
tokens.usage: No tilt (Darkroom: things laid out straight, like contact sheets).

tokens.name: tilt-1
tokens.usage: Barely-there tilt (Fridge, Postcard).

tokens.name: tilt-2
tokens.usage: Paper's tilt: enough to feel handmade, not messy.

tokens.name: tilt-3
tokens.usage: Cork and Zine: loose, pinned-by-hand.
